alongRayUncertainty.rule: held-back same-recording integer-click horizontal error by hit range and triangle tier

carShape.frame: x forward along the upright box heading (front face at x = +L/2), y to the car's left, z above the box bottom (box centre Y - H/2). Same as metric F upright_frame/car_local.

grid.order: index = i*lateral + j; i from the front face, j from the left side

cuboids.frame: worldFromBox columns are box +x forward (length), +y left (width), +z up (height); center is the box centre

poseAverage.convention: offsets are row minus average: along the averaged heading (+ = forward), lateral (+ = left of the heading), vertical (+ = up); population standard deviations; yaw offsets wrapped to [-180, 180) degrees
poseAverage.numInteriorPoints: the sweep row's count, not recomputed for the averaged box

frame.convention: World X=cityX-originX, Y=cityZ-originZ (up), Z=-(cityY-originY); left camera at the world origin

license.changes: Mapped geometry and annotations converted to umbra scene coordinates; other same-recording LiDAR sweeps registered into measured triangles. Scoring sweep excluded; holes retained. No endorsement implied.

limitations: Runtime ground uses other sweeps of the same recording, with the scoring sweep excluded; unmeasured regions stay holes.
The LiDAR agreement check is a consistency check: the publisher built the ground map from LiDAR too.
Annotated cuboids are at the sweep timestamp, about 40 ms before the image; dynamic objects may have moved.
Drivable-area edges are a curb proxy, not measured curbs.
Free space and Clear remain unestablished; results are Blocked or Unknown only.

Protocol v3: the current stationary vehicle (cuboid with poseAverage) is the average of all its annotations in the log (upright, circular-mean heading, median dimensions); every other cuboid is at the sweep timestamp.
Displayed uncertainty uses held-back integer-click errors separately for near-time and other-time ground, without clipping; scoring returns are excluded.
Protocol v3: a mapped-ground hit more than 30 m from the camera (horizontal) is refused.
Sweeps from the same recording remain correlated; physical calibration and terrain contact remain provisional.

suggestionAdapter.horizontalAnchors: unchanged from source suggestions; heights, projections and ray diagnostics refreshed

support.rule: other sweeps of the same recording only; scoring-sweep support rows are not used

terrain.layout: row-major: value(row, column) at float index row*columns+column
terrain.samplingRule: cityX=worldX+cityOrigin[0], cityY=-worldZ+cityOrigin[1]; imageX=s*((R[0]*cityX+R[1]*cityY)+t[0]), imageY=s*((R[2]*cityX+R[3]*cityY)+t[1]); column=trunc(imageX), row=trunc(imageY); no value when any image coordinate is negative, non-finite, outside rasterShape or outside the window; groundWorldY = value - cityOrigin[2]; no interpolation
terrain.values: publisher cityZ (float16 widened exactly to float32); NaN = no value
